snippet.title: Doc Clock: The Toasted Sandwich of Time Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
http://www.docclockgame.com

Lead kooky inventor Doc Clock and his contemptuous robot, Sack, on their first awesome adventure through time to save Doc's beloved cat from a prickly fate.
